stem: Which state government has launched a scheme titled ‘Ashray’ to save girl child ? What is the main aim of the scheme ?

options.A: Uttar Pradesh : Providing 200 crores to save girl child
options.B: Madhya Pradesh : Providing food and clothes to girl child
options.C: Rajasthan : Government to place specially designed cradles in 65 state hospitals for the safe abandoning of girl child
options.D: Haryana : The government to place specially designed cradles in all state hospitals
